notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {C}.
You have had at least three creatures die under your control this turn.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Liliana's Standard Bearer.
When Liliana's Standard Bearer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Repeat from step 4 until you have at least {2}{C} in your mana pool.
If you had additional creatures die this turn and/or the mana-producing permanent produces at least {1}{C}, this combo nets near-infinite mana and near-infinite card draw.
